hero.heading: Four steps, and you know who owns each one.

timeline.heading: Understand your requirements.
timeline.body: — Volume, specs, load behavior, delivery cadence — plus the handling conditions that decide whether a spec survives contact with your floor.

timeline.heading: Align supply and freight.
timeline.body: — We match the spec to qualified shops — more than one — and plan the lanes at the same time, so sourcing and delivery aren't two separate problems.

timeline.heading: Execute and communicate.
timeline.body: — We book, track, and tell you early. Proactive updates, not status requests.

timeline.heading: Keep adjusting.
timeline.body: — Volumes move, specs change, plants open. We re-source and re-route rather than restating the original quote.

ctaBand.heading: Let's talk about your pallet supply.
ctaBand.body: Send a spec and a quantity, or just call and describe the problem.
